title: bibliograph-mcp: a suite of MCP servers for scholarly search with typed envelopes and query receipts
description: The suite package for six Model Context Protocol servers (CiNii Research, J-STAGE, NDL Search, KCI/Open Access Korea, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar) that answer with one typed JSON envelope and deposit hash-chained query receipts to one ledger. Installs the six at pinned release tags from GitHub and registers them in Claude Desktop together; verifies a receipts folder as one deposit.
